_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pelican-eggs/minecraft (MIT).
name: Minecraft: Paper
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Paper, the fast Minecraft Java server that runs Bukkit and Spigot plugins. Any Minecraft version Paper has, checked against PaperMC's checksums, with tuned Java settings.
startup: read -r need 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version needs Java %s or newer, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}} nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Paper. Downloads the Paper build for the chosen Minecraft
# version from PaperMC and checks it against PaperMC's checksum. Worlds,
# plugins and settings are never touched, and the jar is only replaced
# once the new one has downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

api=https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/paper
ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

if [ -n "${DL_PATH:-}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading the server jar from $DL_PATH"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$DL_PATH"
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
    rm -f .raptor-java
    echo "Installed."
    exit 0
fi

versions=$(get "$api/versions") || fail "PaperMC can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
version="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-}"
build="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"
if [ -z "$version" ] || [ "$version" = latest ]; then
    # The newest version PaperMC supports that has a stable build.
    build_json=""
    for v in $(jq -r '.versions[] | select(.version.support.status == "SUPPORTED") | .version.id' <<<"$versions"); do
        if [ "$build" = latest ]; then
            build_json=$(get "$api/versions/$v/builds?channel=STABLE" | jq -c '.[0] // empty') || true
        else
            build_json=$(get "$api/versions/$v/builds/$build") || true
        fi
        if [ -n "$build_json" ]; then version=$v; break; fi
    done
    [ -n "$build_json" ] || fail "PaperMC has no stable build to install right now. Reinstall to try again later."
else
    jq -e --arg v "$version" 'any(.versions[]; .version.id == $v)' <<<"$versions" >/dev/null ||
        fail "Paper has no Minecraft $version. Set Version to latest, or to a version Paper has, such as $(jq -r '.versions[0].version.id' <<<"$versions")."
    if [ "$build" = latest ]; then
        build_json=$(get "$api/versions/$version/builds?channel=STABLE" | jq -c '.[0] // empty') || true
        if [ -z "$build_json" ]; then
            build_json=$(get "$api/versions/$version/builds/latest") || fail "PaperMC can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
            echo "Minecraft $version has no stable Paper build yet, so this is an experimental one."
        fi
    else
        build_json=$(get "$api/versions/$version/builds/$build") ||
            fail "Paper has no build $build for Minecraft $version. Set Build to latest, or to one of its builds."
    fi
fi

id=$(jq -r '.id' <<<"$build_json")
url=$(jq -r '.downloads."server:default".url' <<<"$build_json")
sum=$(jq -r '.downloads."server:default".checksums.sha256' <<<"$build_json")
java=$(jq -r --arg v "$version" '.versions[] | select(.version.id == $v) | .version.java.version.minimum // 8' <<<"$versions")

if [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$jar" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "Paper $version build $id is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Paper $version build $id"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$url"
    [ "$(sha256sum "$jar.new" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || { rm -f "$jar.new"; fail "The download didn't match PaperMC's checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
fi
# The Java version it needs, which the startup command checks.
echo "$java" > .raptor-java
echo "Installed Paper $version build $id. It needs Java $java or newer."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Minecraft version, such as 1.21.4, or latest for the newest one Paper supports. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Build
variables.description: The Paper build for that version, or latest for its newest stable build.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the server's jar file.

variables.name: Download link
variables.description: A link to download the server jar from instead of PaperMC, which only staff can set.
